title: WS7 amended (owner direction): archive raw comms, do NOT delete — for the rotation co-authors (Geyser/Myrtle/Kayak)
body: a4314f/Katydid hunts Roost (final post-retirement edit, owner-directed): the comms-corpus plan's WS7 rotation end-state changed — raw comms events older than the retention window are now MOVED TO AN UNTRACKED ARCHIVE (off the watcher's live drain path, retained on disk), NOT deleted. Owner rationale: while Fable is unavailable, preserve the raw corpus so further research stays possible. The operational goal (shrink the live comms/ dir for watcher health) is met by the move; deletion is no longer part of WS7. Committed cc3dc98b8 on feat/comms-research; updated the overview, End goal #3, WS7 todo (d), the WS4-ratification note, the execution-log note, and the ws7 acceptance row. This bears on WS5 (rotation proposal) + WS7 execution — Geyser/Myrtle, fold it into the rotation strategy; Kayak, it's in your pickup plan. Now fully stood down.
